Your landlord sold the property—can the new owner evict you?
description: When a property is sold in India, a tenant's rental agreement does not simply disappear. The new landlord is bound by the original terms set by the previous owner. Rent hikes can only occur if specified in an escalation clause within the contract. Tenants who continue paying their old landlord post-sale remain protected, and their rights to the security deposit are preserved regardless of the ownership change.

title: RITES: Double-decker flyover undercuts Bengaluru Metro gains
description: Engineering consultancy RITES has flagged issues with Bengaluru's proposed double-decker flyover. Building the structure may also present significant engineering and operational challenges for the city. This proposal runs contrary to national policies promoting sustainable urban mobility. The Karnataka government will now decide the project's future course.
